renderer: Godot 4.7.2 release, Forward Plus, Apple M1 Pro (Apple7)
gpu_timing: Unavailable on this renderer; zero monitor values are not GPU cost measurements.

method.native_focus: NSWorkspace expected/foreground PID sampled every 250 ms, with owned samples bracketing every helper and gameplay phase plus zero in-engine focus-exit events.
method.ordinary: Base: 30 units. Midfield combat: fixed 70 units. Destruction burst: eight tanks removed, leaving 62 units. Each phase retains at least 120 frames and at least 3 seconds of warm-up, followed by 240 drawn steady frames.
method.stress: Synthetic 200 mobile units plus 80 structures, with AI disabled; original 10-simulation-second movement and combat phases preserved. The first 3 wall seconds and remaining frames are post-processing subdivisions, not additional warm-up.
method.cache: Each workload starts with its own fresh game user cache, then repeats in a new process using that cache. OS/driver caches were not reset.
method.helper: Production CombatPrewarm helper-only costs are separate from gameplay timing and exclude fixture preparation. Stress settles navigation, construction rigs and minimap while paused, confirms state stable across another physics/process/draw cycle, then invokes the helper. These values are not end-to-end Loading times.
method.input: Stress input probe measures engine event dispatch to accepted move-feedback frame submission for 24 selected units; excludes mouse hardware and display scan-out.

rejected_stress_run.reason: Baseline captured deferred initialization before it completed; preserve-only diagnostic evidence, excluded from all accepted summaries.

startup_diagnostic.facts: Exactly 34 ConstructionPrewarm rig nodes removed; zero surviving-node mode changes or additions. Exactly 24 snapshot fields changed: 12 mobile movement target/progress positions initialized from zero to spawn. Simulation remained at 0.0 and paused; no fog or other snapshot differences. The navigation diagnostic list was capped at 100 entries; the snapshot difference list is complete.

limitations: Two runs per workload on one Mac; results are scenario measurements, not a general frame-rate guarantee.
Fresh game-cache runs still inherit OS/driver caches.
All Windows work remains paused and no Windows claim is made.
